name: sparekey
description: Unlock your logged-in Mac for authorized GUI tasks and restore the screen lock when the task is done.

interface.shortDescription: A spare key to your Mac, for your AI agent.
interface.longDescription: Checks the screen lock before GUI tasks, unlocks your own logged-in session with the local Sparekey helper, and restores the lock when finished. Requires Sparekey and one-time setup in your local terminal. Credentials stay in the macOS Keychain.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Mac is locked.
Check whether Sparekey is ready for GUI tasks.
Use Sparekey when my GUI task needs this Mac unlocked.
